title: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics enhancements + SLO toolkit integration
author: Jordan Kim
description: Context: On-call teams need faster, higher-signal diagnostics surfaced automatically when an alert triggers. This PR enhances incident-bot to surface SLO-linked diagnostics, include runbook links and a short automated summary, and integrate with the slo-toolkit's recent diagnostic hooks. Motivation: reduce time-to-triage and avoid noisy follow-ups by providing relevant SLO context, recent error-rate windows, and quick links to runbooks and escalation policies directly in the on-call notification. What this change does: 1) Adds an SLO diagnostics module that pulls the latest SLO burn rate and 30m/1h windows from slo-toolkit APIs and formats a concise diagnostic block. 2) Enriches alert payloads with runbook links (project-runbook and oncall-runbook) and a short autogenerated summary (2-3 sentences) highlighting probable root-cause signals. 3) Adds a configurable oncall helper command (/incident-diagnose) that runs the same diagnostics on-demand via Slack/GChat. 4) Implements rate-limited background job to cache SLO snapshots to avoid runtime latency spikes. 5) Adds unit and integration tests, telemetry for diagnostics latency and cache hit-rate, and observability dashboard panels. Migration/compatibility: opt-in via incident-bot config (ENABLE_SLO_DIAGNOSTICS). Default is disabled for customers who haven't installed slo-toolkit. Rollout: feature-flagged, staged to prod after two days in canary. See Linear ENG-4923 for rollout checklist and ENG-5012 for post-rollout monitoring notes.

review_comments: Samira Gupta (review): Nit: please add metrics for cache hit-rate and a circuit-breaker to avoid upstream SLO API storms. Also request clearer error handling when slo-toolkit is unreachable.

Jordan Kim (author): Added cache hit-rate metric and a simple exponential backoff with circuit-breaker. Error handling now falls back to 'SLO data unavailable' in the summary block. See pkg/diagnostics/cache.go changes.
Liam O'Connor (review): Can we make the auto-summary length configurable and ensure it doesn't leak sensitive traces? Also suggest adding a small E2E test exercising the on-demand command.

Jordan Kim (author): Made summary length configurable via config.SummaryMaxSentences (default 3). Auto-summary redacts strings that match KMS-protected patterns; added basic E2E test under internal/tests.
ci_checks: integration-tests: flaky -> rerun passed (external slo-toolkit mocked)
release_notes: - Incident-bot: add SLO diagnostics block to alert payloads with cached SLO snapshots. - New on-call command (/incident-diagnose) to run diagnostics on demand. - Config flag ENABLE_SLO_DIAGNOSTICS to opt in. - Telemetry: diagnostics_latency_ms, diagnostics_cache_hit_rate.
notes_for_oncall: After rollout monitor diagnostics_latency_ms and diagnostics_cache_hit_rate panels. If cache hit rate drops below 70% or latency spikes above 3000ms, roll back the feature flag and investigate slo-toolkit API availability.
